{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nDuplicate rows:")
print(sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the unique values in status
print("\nUnique values in status:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check the unique values in converted
print("\nUnique values in converted:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nSentinel values in customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())"}
